paragraphs: Recycleye builds AI-powered sorting equipment and analytics for waste management businesses. Its equipment includes retrofittable 6-axis robots designed to target and pick DMR. An optical sorter provides high-volume air jet sorting at speed. Recycleye Vision AI scans 100% of objects to provide QA and trend insights.

The AI is based on WasteNet, a database of billions of images, and powers high-volume and targeted sorting automation. Recycleye describes sorting across DMR, WEEE, and C&D applications throughout Europe and the USA. The company reports installations in locations across Europe and the United States.

Case studies on the solutions page name FCC Environment, Panda Ireland and Bryson Recycling as clients. The about page names a UK partnership with FANUC. Recycleye states a mission to serve the waste and materials management sectors.

quote.text: Turning the world’s waste into resource.
